name: Lut Desert
description: The Lut Desert, or Dasht-e Lut ("Plain of Emptiness"), spreads across south-eastern Iran. Between June and October, fierce winds carve the land into yardangs, huge corrugated ridges, and also shape wide stony plains and dune fields. It is also remarkably hot: sand here has been measured at 70.7 °C, the highest land surface temperature recorded on Earth.
